cases.requires: real Google auth SDK and synthetic captured public claim fixtures
reject: same service account without Compute claims
cases.action: Review qualified Google identity and audience evidence for the selected target.
expected_observations: Verified signature, audience, service-account subject and Compute incarnation agree.
evidence_required: Token-claim summary with secret material redacted.
stop_conditions: Stop if identity or exact audience cannot be established.

cases.requires: InstancesClient response fixture and disposable-project scope later
reject: new numeric ID under reused name
cases.action: Inspect selected immutable VM/image identities and private Spot configuration from existing approved evidence.
expected_observations: Numeric instance ID and creation timestamp match the owned allocation.
Provider acceptance alone does not establish exact absence.
evidence_required: Exact instance/image identity and authoritative provider readback.
stop_conditions: Stop and preserve charged capacity on unknown identity or state.

cases.requires: actual Firestore emulator or approved isolated project later
assert: pool and job JSON-string receipt mutate atomically
concurrent claims mint at most once
SDK retry callback preserves claim ownership
cancel/completion/expiry/incarnation drift during mint prevents release
uncertain mint or commit never resets claim or frees capacity
known provider orphan ID survives cancellation
Python codec preserves every string/bool field
cases.action: Record the held transaction prerequisite; do not install or invoke an emulator from this packet.
expected_observations: Atomicity and SDK retry observations remain unestablished while issue 49 is held.
evidence_required: Separately authorized revision-bound transaction result when available.
stop_conditions: Stop: this prerequisite is held and must not be retried by another route.

cases.requires: qualified auth-app declaration/lock and API fixtures
assert: installation auth administration permission exact
stable repository ID and private repository
operator name case comparison does not rehash stored event
JIT runner ID/name/labels match
JIT provider lifetime evidenced independently from release deadline
pagination changes/errors are unknown
only exact permission-qualified 404 means absent
delete outcome is re-read
raw SDK error/private key/material never logged
cases.action: Review existing App authority, JIT lifetime and runner-identity evidence for the single trusted repository.
expected_observations: Broker releaseBeforeMs and upstream providerExpiresAtMs are recorded separately.
Unknown upstream expiry remains unknown; shared labels do not prove job association.
evidence_required: Authority summary, runner ID and independent upstream JIT expiry observation.
stop_conditions: Stop on unknown JIT expiry, authority or job identity; never print JIT material.

cases.requires: qualified exact image/runner digest and systemd environment
assert: unprivileged private directory and verified fresh runner installation
no management secret in image/env/argv
no Docker socket/sudo/management IAM
readiness retries but one exchange only
lost exchange response does not remint
restart/preemption/power-loss consumed-startup persists where VM remains
no second job or automatic registration
upstream JIT argv exposure documented
local exit/stop never counts as job completion
cases.action: Trace the allowlisted source and verified runner release to the selected build and observed worker.
expected_observations: Pin and install checksum are distinct from the observed post-start version and executable hash.
No second registration, remint or privileged shared host is assumed.
evidence_required: Source-stage manifest, build/image identities, effective version and update observations.
stop_conditions: Stop if provenance, post-start update behavior or one-job containment is unknown.

cases.requires: controller signed workflow_job evidence and cleanup integration
assert: actual runner ID/name and repository/run/job/attempt match issued identity
different eligible job picked through shared labels is not claimed as reserved job
busy/unknown/missing completion preserved
orphan created during unissued mint reconciled by controller
external actor/restart boundary explicit
cases.action: Correlate the ordinary trusted job and any cancellation with issued runner and allocation identities.
expected_observations: Signed completion matches repository/run/job/attempt and issued runner.
Worker acknowledgement and process exit do not establish job completion.
evidence_required: Redacted signed event summary and durable allocation/runner correlation.
stop_conditions: Stop and retain state for busy workers, lost callbacks or ambiguous completion.

cases.requires: provider parse/plan and later explicitly approved live negative cases
assert: worker can invoke exact bootstrap and pull only required image repo
worker cannot read management secret/backend/state or actAs/manage Compute
old broad and inherited grants removed or identified
controller secret binding version-vs-resource limitation recorded
worker cannot invoke retirement
private network egress/control-plane reachability qualified
cases.action: Trace the reviewed Terraform and identities to separately authorized effective-IAM observations.
expected_observations: Worker has no management secrets, authoritative state writes or Compute management authority.
Private egress and broker reachability are observations, not consequences of Terraform syntax passing.
evidence_required: Reviewed plan/identity summary and effective-IAM/network observations.
stop_conditions: Stop when inherited or effective authority is unknown or broader than reviewed.

cases.action: Prepare one ordinary job at capacity one, then capacity two only after the first trial and cleanup are evidenced; describe cancellation/recovery and cleanup without executing them.
expected_observations: One job per disposable VM within reviewed job/build/time/cost bounds.
Acceptance of stop/delete is followed by exact instance and runner absence readback.
Uncertain resources remain charged; never delete state to manufacture capacity.
evidence_required: Capacity-one result before capacity two, actual job identity, cancellation/recovery result and exact cleanup receipt.
stop_conditions: Stop at a limit, lost ownership or unknown cleanup; retain evidence and involve the cleanup owner.
